snippet.title: Forgotten Possessions - Announcement Trailer #indiegame #vrhorror #metaquest #scary
snippet.description:
A stealth-horror adventure where your curiosity and your mind are your only survival tools. In a dark, atmospheric cabin haunted by a disturbing creature, you must move quietly to escape. Every movement, every sound could mean the end. Collect forgotten items and uncover dark secrets while hiding from something that could be lurking around every corner.

Coming Fall 2025
